reasons: The inserted Section 9(c) supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: dual professional and workmanlike standards, express documentation conformance for both Services (90 days from performance) and deliverables/software (12 months from delivery), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and all three remedies.
The insertion is a concise new subsection filling an entirely absent performance warranty; the mutual authority warranties in 9(a) and the Globix carve-out in 9(b) are untouched and remain effective.
No new undefined terms or dangling mechanics: "Services" is defined in the inserted text and the remedy is tied to the new Section 9(c).
